data_cdn_meta.name: schemas/manifest-v60/workflow.schema.json
data_cdn_meta.description: Per-workflow file shape for manifests/<saas>/workflows/<name>.yaml. Phase 4 of the 2026-05-16 four-cleanup refactor: replaces the legacy test_catalog.json (single bare array) with per-workflow files so a SaaS can have multiple independent workflows (opportunity_crud, lead_crud, account_crud) and the runner / wizard / validator address them by name.
data_cdn_meta.regenerate_requires: spec 60.3 §D3.5 — TS source-of-truth generator path; currently hand-rolled.
changelog: 1.0.0 (2026-05-16): initial. Workflow body = { name, description?, inputs?, steps[] }. Each step matches the Phase 3 TestCatalogEntry shape (id, action, flavor, commit?, inputs?, depends_on?, input_from?, expected_outcome?).

title: Spec 60 — manifests/<saas>/workflows/<name>.yaml body
description: Validates the body of a per-workflow YAML file after the _meta block is stripped. Multiple workflows per SaaS live as sibling files in workflows/; the file basename is the workflow name (e.g. workflows/opportunity_crud.yaml → name: 'opportunity_crud').

name.description: Workflow identifier. MUST match the file basename (workflows/<name>.yaml).

inputs.description: Workflow-level inputs (rare). Most steps source inputs from earlier steps via input_from.

id.description: Step id. Unique within the workflow; referenced by depends_on / input_from of later steps.

action.description: Action name in the manifest (matches actions/<verb>.yaml).

flavor.description: Flavor name (typically 'dom' for the Phase 3 single-flavor shape; 'session_api' / 'oauth_api' / etc. for API alternatives).

commit.description: Phase 3 commit mode for the single-`dom`-flavor shape. true = run full recipe + watch post_commit outcomes; false = skip commit-marked steps + watch pre_commit outcomes.

inputs.description: Step-level inputs. Override probe synthesis; yield to input_from values.

depends_on.description: Step ids of parents whose outcomes this step needs. The runner topo-sorts.

input_from.description: Map of THIS step's input field name → dotted path (`<parent_id>.outcomes.<extract_key>`) resolved against parent step's completed outcome.data.

expected_outcome.description: Optional. Asserts the runner observed this outcome.action.
